caption: A red sock is dropped into a basin of hot soapy water holding white shirts, and the water around it turns pink.

sa.check: A basin of hot soapy water holds white shirts.
A red sock is dropped in.
The water around it turns pink.
The shirts nearest the sock take on a faint pink tinge.
The sock goes in first and the pink spreads after.

pc.expect: The pink spreads out from the sock through the water and does not clear again.
pc.fail: The water clears again; or is pink before the sock; or the pink retreats to the sock.

pc.expect: The water is pink and the sock stays red; the nearest shirts take a faint tinge.
pc.fail: The sock turns white; or the water turns a colour other than pink; or far shirts turn deep red at once.

pc.expect: The water is liquid and the dye drifts in it.
pc.fail: The water is rigid; or the dye is a solid lump; or beads bounce.

pc.expect: The sock sinks or settles among the shirts.
pc.fail: It floats above the water; or rises out; or hangs.

pc.expect: One sock and the shirts keep their number.
pc.fail: A second sock appears; or a shirt vanishes; or the sock passes through the basin.

pc.expect: The basin and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The basin changes colour; or the room rearranges; or the shirts change shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
